title: Interactive Portfolio Engine
summary: This site. A feature-driven Next.js sandbox with a code-split WebGL hero.
description: The portfolio you are looking at right now. Built to demonstrate enterprise-grade architecture in a small codebase: feature-isolated modules under /features, a React Three Fiber starfield hero that is code-split with next/dynamic and ssr: false so it never blocks the initial paint, and a strict lint/format/commit pipeline (ESLint with no-any, Prettier, Husky + lint-staged).
